  if (window.__l10nStop) window.__l10nStop();

  const norm = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/\s*:\s*$/, '');
  const PH = /\{\{?\s*\w+\s*\}?\}/;
  const toRegex = (s) => new RegExp('^' + s.split(/\{\{?\s*\w+\s*\}?\}/).map((p) => p.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')).join('.+') + '$');

  const frExact = new Set(), frRegex = [], frPrefix = [], enExact = new Map(), enRegex = [], enPrefix = [];
  for (const [key, v] of Object.entries(DICT)) {
    const en = norm(v.en), fr = norm(v.fr);
    if (fr) {
      if (PH.test(fr)) frRegex.push(toRegex(fr));
      else { frExact.add(fr); if (fr.length >= 6) frPrefix.push(fr); }
    }
    if (en && en !== fr) {
      const item = { key, expected: v.fr };
      if (PH.test(en)) enRegex.push({ ...item, re: toRegex(en) });
      else { if (!enExact.has(en)) enExact.set(en, item); if (en.length >= 8) enPrefix.push({ ...item, en }); }
    }
  }

  const isVisible = (el) => {
    if (!el || !el.getClientRects || el.getClientRects().length === 0) return false;
    const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
    return cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && cs.display !== 'none';
  };
  const collect = () => {
    const out = [];
    const walk = (root) => {
      const tw = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      let n;
      while ((n = tw.nextNode())) {
        const el = n.parentElement;
        if (!el || /^(SCRIPT|STYLE|NOSCRIPT|TEMPLATE)$/.test(el.tagName)) continue;
        const t = norm(n.textContent);
        if (t && /\p{L}/u.test(t) && isVisible(el)) out.push({ text: t, el, where: 'text' });
      }
      root.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {
        for (const a of ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label']) {
          const t = norm(el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(a));
          if (t && /\p{L}/u.test(t) && isVisible(el)) out.push({ text: t, el, where: a });
        }
        if (el.shadowRoot) walk(el.shadowRoot);
      });
    };
    walk(document.body);
    return out;
  };

  let marked = [];
  const clear = () => { marked.forEach(([el, o]) => (el.style.outline = o)); marked = []; };
  const mark = (el, style) => { marked.push([el, el.style.outline]); el.style.outline = style; };

  const screens = [];
  let lastSig = '', stableTicks = 0, lastPrinted = '';

  const scan = () => {
    clear();
    const ok = new Map(), english = new Map(), raw = new Map(), unknown = new Map();
    for (const f of collect()) {
      const t = f.text;
      if (/SURVEYMOD_[A-Z0-9_]+/.test(t)) { raw.set(t, f); continue; }
      if (frExact.has(t) || frRegex.some((re) => re.test(t)) || frPrefix.some((p) => t.startsWith(p + ' ') || t.startsWith(p + ':'))) { ok.set(t, f); continue; }
      const hit = enExact.get(t) || enRegex.find((x) => x.re.test(t)) || enPrefix.find((x) => t.startsWith(x.en + ' ') || t.startsWith(x.en + ':'));
      if (hit) { english.set(t, { ...f, key: hit.key, expected: hit.expected }); continue; }
      unknown.set(t, f);
    }
    ok.forEach((f) => mark(f.el, '2px solid #1db954'));
    english.forEach((f) => mark(f.el, '3px solid red'));
    raw.forEach((f) => mark(f.el, '3px solid red'));
    return { ok, english, raw, unknown };
  };

  const tick = () => {
    const r = scan();
    const sig = [...r.ok.keys(), '|', ...r.english.keys(), '|', ...r.unknown.keys()].join('~') + location.pathname;
    if (sig === lastSig) stableTicks++; else { stableTicks = 0; lastSig = sig; }
    if (stableTicks !== 1 || sig === lastPrinted) return; // print once the screen has settled
    lastPrinted = sig;
    const name = `${location.pathname} #${screens.length + 1}`;
    screens.push({ name, ok: r.ok.size, english: [...r.english.values()], raw: [...r.raw.keys()], unknown: [...r.unknown.keys()] });
    console.log(`%c[FR] ${name} | ✅ ${r.ok.size} matched | ❌ ${r.english.size + r.raw.size} still English/raw | ❔ ${r.unknown.size} not in sheet`, 'font-weight:bold;font-size:13px');
    if (r.english.size) { console.log('%c❌ Still in English (should be French):', 'color:red;font-weight:bold'); console.table([...r.english.values()].map((f) => ({ Text: f.text, Key: f.key, Expected: f.expected, Where: f.where }))); }
    if (r.raw.size) { console.log('%c❌ Raw translation keys on screen:', 'color:red;font-weight:bold'); console.table([...r.raw.keys()].map((t) => ({ Text: t }))); }
    if (r.unknown.size) { console.log('%c❔ Not in the sheet (no outline) - check by eye; dataset/user text is fine:', 'color:#c80;font-weight:bold'); console.table([...r.unknown.values()].map((f) => ({ Text: f.text, Where: f.where }))); }
  };

  const timer = setInterval(tick, 1500);
  tick();

  window.__l10nStop = () => { clearInterval(timer); clear(); console.log('[FR] stopped'); };
  window.__l10nClear = clear;
  window.__l10nTotal = () => {
    const eng = new Map(), unk = new Set();
    screens.forEach((s) => { s.english.forEach((f) => eng.set(f.text, { Text: f.text, Expected: f.expected, Screen: s.name })); s.raw.forEach((t) => eng.set(t, { Text: t, Expected: '(raw key)', Screen: s.name })); s.unknown.forEach((t) => unk.add(t)); });
    console.log(`%c[FR TOTAL] screens: ${screens.length} | matched (sum): ${screens.reduce((a, s) => a + s.ok, 0)} | still English: ${eng.size} | not in sheet: ${unk.size}`, 'font-weight:bold;font-size:13px');
    if (eng.size) console.table([...eng.values()]);
    if (unk.size) console.table([...unk].map((t) => ({ Text: t })));
  };
  console.log('%c[FR] watching. Switch screens / open dialogs; results print here. __l10nTotal() for summary, __l10nStop() to stop.', 'color:#1db954;font-weight:bold');
})();
